topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 139 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 117 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs, 2 ERC1155 multi-tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc165, erc721holder, erc1155burnable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
